exclusions.basis: The defect is a struct-size mismatch inside the per-element default-attribute name hash table: dtdCopy inserts entries with sizeof(NAMED) while storeAtts casts them to NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE (PR for 2.8.4), so attIndex is read past the allocation. That table (m_defaultAttForName / defaultAttsNames) was introduced by the CVE-2026-45186 fix in 2.8.1; at R_2_6_2 dtdCopy copies the DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE array directly (xmlparse.c:7020, :7029-7035) and storeAtts resolves isCdata by walking elementType->defaultAtts (xmlparse.c:3456-3457, :3512). No such table entry is ever created, so the out-of-bounds read cannot occur at this tag.

not_promotable.reason: Fix 9bdfbc77e335 adds the defaultAttsNames hash table and rewrites dtdCopy attribute copying; the table does not exist at R_2_6_2. Whether the pre-2.8.1 attributeIds lookups can still be driven quadratic needs a runtime audit, so the row stays open.

Fix e97a6c453a4e changes the defaultAttForName table introduced by CVE-2026-45186, which is absent at R_2_6_2; left open with 45186 rather than excluded because the older per-attribute isCdata lookup path is not obviously collision-free.

Fix 3fd4d1c19c30 introduces m_handlerCallDepth with beforeHandler/afterHandler and isCalledFromInsideHandler to reject reentrant API calls; none of those helpers exist at R_2_6_2, so the guard the advisory describes has no pre-image to anchor.
Fix 6f80c72c0edf routes the unknown-encoding convert/release callbacks through beforeHandler/afterHandler; depends on the same post-50219 depth tracking that R_2_6_2 lacks.
The fix is only reachable through a fuzz harness that feeds one parser twice in a single execution; the frozen library exposes no anchored statement whose absence proves the defect.
The OSV record carries no fixed event and no patch commit was recovered, so there is no fix marker to compare against the frozen tree.
